servers_json.description: MCP servers to connect, as a JSON array. Each entry: { "name": "filesystem", "transport": "stdio", "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem", "/data"], "autoTools": [] } for a local server, or { "name": "github", "transport": "http", "url": "https://mcp.example.com/sse", "headers": { "Authorization": "Bearer …" }, "autoTools": ["search"] } for a remote one. Each server's tools appear as mcp__<name>__<tool>; names in autoTools run without asking, the rest prompt for approval. Set "enabled": false to keep a server configured without connecting it.
